title: Purair® FLOW Laminar Flow Cabinets
meta_title: Purair FLOW Laminar Flow Cabinets - Vertical Airflow Hoods
meta_description: Purair FLOW Series benchtop laminar flow cabinets provide vertical laminar airflow with HEPA/ULPA filtration to protect materials from particulates. Ideal for laboratory environments.
meta_keywords: laminar flow cabinet, laminar flow hood, vertical laminar flow, HEPA filtration, clean bench, laboratory equipment
short_description: Purair® FLOW Series benchtop laminar flow cabinets are compact and ideal for laboratory environments with limited space. The vertical laminar flow hoods use HEPA filtration to protect equipment and other contents of the work zone from particulates.
full_description: Vertical laminar airflow with HEPA/ULPA filtration protects materials inside the cabinet from particulates. High efficiency ebm-papst centrifugal fan. Air cleanliness meets and exceeds ISO Class 5. Energy saving LED lighting. Large front opening provides unrestricted access to the work zone.
seo_content: Purair FLOW Series laminar flow cabinets are designed for non-hazardous applications where user protection from biologicals or biohazardous byproducts is not required. Ideal for use in mycology, food microbiology, cell culture, cleanrooms, semiconductor assembly, pharmaceutical production, and more.
features_data: Vertical laminar airflow with HEPA/ULPA filtration
Air cleanliness meets and exceeds ISO Class 5
Large front opening for unrestricted access
